cases.name: return-override private field rejects non-extensible object
cases.source: class B{constructor(o){return o;}}class A extends B{#v;constructor(o){super(o);this.#v=42;}static v(o){return o.#v;}}const t=new A({});if(A.v(t)!==42)throw 70;let ok=false;const s=Object.preventExtensions({});try{new A(s);}catch(e){ok=e instanceof TypeError;}if(!ok)throw 71;

cases.name: return-override private method and accessor reject non-extensible object
cases.source: class B{constructor(o){return o;}}class M extends B{#m(){return 1;}static has(o){return #m in o;}}class G extends B{get #g(){return 2;}static has(o){return #g in o;}}for(const C of [M,G]){if(!C.has(new C({})))throw 72;const s=Object.preventExtensions({});let ok=false;try{new C(s);}catch(e){ok=e instanceof TypeError;}if(!ok||C.has(s))throw 73;}

cases.name: base preventExtensions(this) blocks derived private elements
cases.source: class N{constructor(seal){if(seal)Object.preventExtensions(this);}}class F extends N{#v=1;}class M extends N{#m(){}}class P extends N{x=1;}for(const C of [F,M,P]){new C(false);let ok=false;try{new C(true);}catch(e){ok=e instanceof TypeError;}if(!ok)throw 74;}

cases.name: existing private fields stay writable after seal and freeze
cases.source: class B{constructor(o){return o;}}class A extends B{#a=1;static get(o){return o.#a;}static inc(o){o.#a++;}}const o={};new A(o);Object.seal(o);A.inc(o);if(A.get(o)!==2)throw 75;Object.freeze(o);A.inc(o);if(A.get(o)!==3||!Object.isFrozen(o))throw 76;

cases.name: proxy isExtensible is observed per field and once per method batch
cases.source: class B{constructor(o){return o;}}let n=0;const p=()=>new Proxy({},{isExtensible(t){n++;return Reflect.isExtensible(t);}});class F extends B{#a;#b;x=1;}class M extends B{#m(){}#n(){}get #g(){return 0;}}class E extends B{x=1;}new F(p());if(n!==2)throw 77;n=0;new M(p());if(n!==1)throw 78;n=0;new E(p());if(n!==0)throw 79;

cases.name: throwing isExtensible trap aborts private element addition
cases.source: class B{constructor(o){return o;}}const err={};const p=new Proxy({},{isExtensible(){throw err;}});class F extends B{#a;static has(o){return #a in o;}}class M extends B{#m(){}static has(o){return #m in o;}}for(const C of [F,M]){let ok=false;try{new C(p);}catch(e){ok=e===err;}if(!ok||C.has(p))throw 80;}

cases.name: private field initializer runs before the extensibility rejection
cases.source: class B{constructor(o){return o;}}const log=[];class A extends B{#x=(log.push('x'),1);y=log.push('y');}let ok=false;try{new A(Object.preventExtensions({}));}catch(e){ok=e instanceof TypeError;}if(!ok||log.join()!=='x')throw 81;

cases.name: this stays bound when instance element initialization rejects
cases.source: class B{constructor(o){return o;}}class A extends B{#x;constructor(o){try{super(o);}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof TypeError))throw 82;}}static has(o){return #x in o;}}const s=Object.preventExtensions({});const r=new A(s);if(r!==s||A.has(s))throw 83;

cases.name: static private field rejects a non-extensible class constructor
cases.source: const log=[];let ok=false;try{class C{static{Object.preventExtensions(this);}static #x=(log.push('x'),1);}}catch(e){ok=e instanceof TypeError;}if(!ok||log.join()!=='x')throw 84;class D{static #m(){return 5;}static m(){return D.#m();}}if(D.m()!==5)throw 85;
